page_title: REN 2-1 MNT | Rennes v Montpellier 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Flag up against Bertug Yildirim (Rennes). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90+1' Julien Stephan prepares a substitution. Enzo Le Fee is replaced by Alidu Seidu (Rennes).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Steve Mandanda, who smothers the ball.
87' Here comes a substitution. Modibo Sagnan is given a rest as he is replaced by Leo Leroy (Montpellier).
86' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
86' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
85' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Benjamin Lecomte is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
84' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:17.
82' That's the end of the game for Benjamin Bourigeaud, who is replaced by Azor Matusiwa (Rennes).
82' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
80' Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
79' The corner from Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is cleared away by the defence.
77' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
77' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Steve Mandanda as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
76' Michel Der Zakarian is forced to make a change. Tanguy Coulibaly is unable to continue due to injury, Axel Gueguin (Montpellier) comes on.
76' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

73' 2 - 1 Goal! Teji Savanier (Montpellier) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Steve Mandanda is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:1.
73' Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Martin Terrier trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
71' Julien Stephan has decided to substitute Arnaud Kalimuendo and he is replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
70' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) causes Steve Mandanda little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
68' Here is a change. Khalil Fayad is going off and Michel Der Zakarian gives the last tactical orders to Yann Karamoh (Montpellier).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joris Chotard departs the field of play to be replaced by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier).
68' Here's the change. Enzo Tchato leaves the pitch and Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) comes on as a substitute.
66' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Rennes players look gutted.
66' Wait! Referee Mathieu Vernice has indicated he is going to review the Rennes goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
65' Goal! Amine Gouiri (Rennes) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 3:0.
65' Guela Doue (Rennes) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Benjamin Lecomte is alert and denies him with a nice save.

63' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Steve Mandanda shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
60' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
60' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
57' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the left post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
57' Corner kick. Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is ready to send the ball into the box.
56' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
53' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
52' Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
52' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Montpellier.
51' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Steve Mandanda easily deals with the threat.
48' 2 - 0 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Benjamin Lecomte to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
47' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
47' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
46' Mathieu Vernice blows the whistle, Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) is penalised for a foul. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Rennes!
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Julien Stephan probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Desire Doue. He is replaced by Amine Gouiri (Rennes).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Mathieu Vernice has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
45+3' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

45+2' Martin Terrier (Rennes) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Benjamin Lecomte makes a great save.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
44' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle and it's Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

42' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the left side of the goal, but it lacks power and Steve Mandanda pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
40' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
39' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Desire Doue (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
36' Guela Doue (Rennes) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

35' Desire Doue (Rennes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mathieu Vernice with no other option than to blow for a foul.
32' A pass lands at the feet of Guela Doue (Rennes) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
31' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) is able to continue to play.
30' The game is interrupted now, Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Mathieu Vernice and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
28' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
27' Montpellier hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
24' Total attempts – 4:1.
21' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) commits a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
20' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) inside the box.
18' A dangerous towering header by Arthur Theate (Rennes) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
18' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
17' The ball is cleared after Arthur Theate (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
17' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.
16' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
13' Arthur Theate (Rennes) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
12' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
11' Martin Terrier (Rennes) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
8' Guela Doue (Rennes) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
5' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) was too forceful with his tackle and Mathieu Vernice interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
4' Mathieu Vernice sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
3' The Rennes players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. Martin Terrier (Rennes) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
1' The first half has started.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Mathieu Vernice is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
